tests.title: Admin creates branch protection rule on main requiring 1 approval and test success, then updates PR check to success: rule and check persist and merge eligibility enforced
checks: Settings → Branches shows one rule for `main` with summary '1 approval' and 'Require status check test' after reload
Checks area displays `test: success`, setter, and time and retains after reload
PR without 1 valid non-author approval, with any Request changes, or with test not success is unmergeable
Direct write to protected `main` is blocked
Non-admin does not see a savable rule-editing entry or the request is rejected with rule unchanged

tests.title: Non-admin attempts to create or modify branch protection rule: controls absent or rejected and no protection rule is saved
checks: Add branch protection rule control is absent for non-admin even if Settings/Branches remain accessible
Any attempted create/modify request is rejected
No protection rule is present in Settings after reload
Original branch protection state remains unchanged

tests.title: Admin updates PR check test from pending to success in Checks area: success/setter/time persist for that compare commit; new compare commit resets to pending
checks: Checks area displays `test: success`, setter, and update time after Save
Refresh of PR detail page retains the success status for the same compare commit
When compare branch gains a new commit, new compare commit starts with pending
Old success from previous compare commit cannot be used for merging

tests.title: Filter PR list by Open and author alice: only the Open PR appears with metadata, clicking its title opens the detail page
checks: Selecting Open and filtering author to `alice` displays only the Open PR
Row shows number, title, source/target branches, author, and status
Result title link has accessible name equal to the PR title and opens a detail page with same title heading
Switching to Closed hides the Open PR and filtering does not change any PR data

tests.title: Reload or reopen the filtered Open/author PR list: the same Open PR remains visible and filter context is kept
checks: After reloading the filtered list, the Open PR is still displayed
Leaving and reopening the list then selecting Open again shows the same PR
No PR status, review, or branch data is modified by filtering or reload

tests.title: Closed-status filter shows the Closed PR and excludes the Open PR; filtering is read-only
checks: Selecting Closed displays the Closed PR created by `alice` and excludes the Open PR
List rows still show number, title, author, status, and source/target branches
PR records and review data remain unchanged after switching filters

tests.title: Compare main to feature-search: shows commit summary, changed file src/search.ts, diff summary, and enabled Create pull request
checks: Selecting base `main` and compare `feature-search` and clicking Compare changes shows both branch names
Page displays at least one comparable commit and changed file path `src/search.ts` verbatim
Create pull request entry is enabled
Comparison is read-only and creates no PR, commit, or branch change

tests.title: Select same branch for base and compare: shows No changes and disables Create pull request without Compare changes click
checks: Selecting the same branch in both fields immediately displays No changes
Creation entry remains disabled without requiring Compare changes
No PR, commit, or branch change is made

tests.title: Create Open PR from valid main/feature-search comparison: detail page shows exact title, Open status, branches, author, and persists
checks: Redirects to new PR detail page with unique repository-scoped number and Open status
Heading accessible name equals entered title; description and author are visible
Source/target branches are stored as `main` and `feature-search`
After refresh and in PR list, the PR still exists with same title and status

tests.title: Submit PR creation form with a title containing only spaces: shows 'Title is required' and creates no PR record
checks: Submitting title '   ' displays visible message 'Title is required'
No new issue number or partial PR record is created
Original comparison page state remains and PR list has no new PR

tests.title: Create draft PR from valid comparison: detail shows Draft marker, source/target branches, disabled Merge, and persists
checks: Create draft pull request button opens form with Title and optional Description
Detail page displays Draft marker and source/target branch names
Merge pull request entry is present but disabled
After refresh draft status and content remain; invalid comparison creates no draft

tests.title: Mark draft PR 'Draft onboarding update' ready for review: status becomes Open, Draft badge removed, title/branches unchanged, activity recorded
checks: Author sees Ready for review button and confirms with single Confirm button
Same PR number transitions from Draft to Open and Draft marker disappears
Ready for review activity is appended to Conversation
After refresh or reviewer reopen, PR is Open; source `draft-feature` and target `main` unchanged

tests.title: Open public PR detail and switch Conversation/Commits/Files changed: all views show same PR number, title, and read-only content
checks: PR title appears as exact heading and description is visible in Conversation
Commits tab displays commit summary for the PR
Files changed tab displays changed-files summary
All three tabs reference the same PR number and do not create comments, reviews, or branch updates

tests.title: Refresh any PR detail tab: title, branches, commit list, and navigation links remain unchanged
checks: After refresh, PR title heading remains exact
Conversation, Commits, and Files changed links remain usable
Branches and commit data displayed are unchanged
No new comments, reviews, or merges are created

tests.title: Leave and reopen same public PR page directly: same PR and navigation tabs are restored
checks: Directly reopening the PR address restores same title, status, and branch data
Visitor can again open Conversation, Commits, and Files changed
No sign-in required for public PR and no mutation occurs

tests.title: Visitor opens Files changed on public PR: displays src/search.ts, per-file diff, aggregate additions/deletions, and remains read-only
checks: Files changed link is activated and changed file path `src/search.ts` is displayed verbatim
Aggregate text matches format '<n> additions, <m> deletions' for one added and one modified file
Diff blocks show added/deleted lines and no unchanged files
After refresh or returning to Conversation, files and PR/review status unchanged

tests.title: Add single inline review comment on changed line: comment appears in diff and Conversation, anchored to file/line, persists after reload
checks: Clicking + on changed line and choosing Add single comment publishes the comment
Comment body and reviewer username appear in the diff and Conversation
Comment is stored with PR, file path, compare commit, and line position
After reload the comment remains; empty or failed submission adds no partial comment

tests.title: Start a review from an inline comment: comment is kept pending, not public, and retained as draft after reload
checks: Selecting Start a review instead of Add single comment keeps comment pending
Pending review is visible only to the author
Comment is not published in Conversation before review submission
Pending draft is retained after reload

tests.title: Submit Approve review on Open PR: shows Approved, overall comment, time and persists; merge eligibility can read decision
checks: Review changes form opens; Approve radio selected and Submit review activates
Conversation and review summary display reviewer, Approved, overall comment, and time
Decision persists after reload
A new decision by same reviewer replaces effective decision; failed or unauthorized submission persists nothing

tests.title: Submit Request changes review: displays Changes requested with exact summary and persists after reload
checks: Select Request changes and enter summary, then Submit review
Review summary displays Changes requested and the exact summary text
Decision remains visible after reload
Request changes blocks merging until new decision or new compare commit makes it stale

tests.title: Author requests bob-reviewer then removes request: Reviewers area updates immediately, final state persists, non-authors cannot modify
checks: Typing in Search reveals eligible username option with exact accessible name
Selecting option saves reviewer request immediately, displays username, and persists after reload
Remove <username> button removes request without confirmation and persists
Request creates no approval or comment; non-author/non-maintainer cannot modify requests

tests.title: Maintainer merges eligible protected PR with Create a merge commit: PR shows Merged, main branch head updated, merge commit persists
checks: Eligible PR has valid non-author approval, test: success, and no conflicts
Only merge method 'Create a merge commit'; Merge pull request then Confirm merge
PR displays Merged with merger, time, and resulting commit identifier
After refresh PR and main branch show merged state and resulting commit

tests.title: Blocked PR without required approval shows disabled Merge button and 'Review required by branch protection'; PR and branch unchanged
checks: Merge pull request button is disabled before any click
Visible message 'Review required by branch protection' accompanies the disabled button
PR remains Open and target branch head and commits are unchanged
After reload the blocked state persists

tests.title: Author closes then reopens PR without merging: status Closed->Open with timeline events, discussion/diff/branches unchanged, persists
checks: Close pull request immediately sets Closed; Reopen pull request immediately restores Open
Timeline records close and reopen events in sequence
No merge or target branch update occurs; discussion and diff remain viewable
After refresh final Open state is retained and Close pull request is available again

tests.title: Unauthorized viewer who is not author/maintainer has no close/reopen controls and cannot change PR status
checks: Close pull request and Reopen pull request buttons are absent for the viewer
Direct status-change requests are rejected
PR status remains unchanged after reload
